description:
48V 13.5AH LONG-RANGE BATTERY - The high-capacity rechargeable battery provides a maximum travel range of up to 30 miles per charge, making the scooter suitable for commuting, neighborhood rides, shopping trips, and everyday errands. Actual range may vary based on rider weight, terrain, speed, incline, temperature, and riding conditions.

THREE SELECTABLE SPEED MODES - Choose from three riding modes with approximate top speeds of 12.4, 15.5, and 18.6 MPH. The daylight-viewable LCD screen displays real-time speed, battery level, selected mode, and lighting status for convenient ride management.

DETACHABLE FRONT & REAR BASKETS - Carry groceries, bags, and other daily essentials in the spacious removable baskets. The front basket features an openable side door for easier loading and unloading, while the rear basket provides additional organized storage.

COMFORTABLE SEATED RIDING - The wide cushioned saddle and spacious non-slip deck support a relaxed riding position. Front and rear suspension components help absorb bumps and road vibration for greater comfort across paved roads and other firm surfaces.

COMMUTER-READY SAFETY FEATURES - Front and rear disc brakes provide responsive stopping control, while the bright headlight and rear reflector improve visibility. The UL2272-certified electrical system, durable frame, fenders, bell, and kickstand add convenience for everyday transportation. Always wear appropriate protective equipment and observe local riding regulations.
